propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed with matching --class parameter without --force, because close_plan_review_gate_check is never passed the close_class disposition parameter and unconditionally demands a plan-review attestation

Administrative dispositions (superseded, duplicate) that legitimately skip completion verification via live-link evidence cannot pass plan-review close gate because they are unsatisfiable by construction—a reviewed plan for already-delivered work guarantees reviewer BLOCK

The plan-review close gate lacks awareness of evidence-backed administrative dispositions, while the completion-verification gate (close_precheck) already honors the same link-backed evidence, creating an asymmetry introduced when ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES was extended to task/story/epic in commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab

Superseded tickets can only be closed via --force, which records no signed attestation and degrades the audit trail for the entire ancestor chain, stripping completion signatures from epics containing legitimately superseded children

The plan-review close gate must accept close_class and tracker as keyword-only parameters and exempt only link-backed dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when _has_live_replacement_link returns True, leaving reason-required dispositions (obsolete, wontfix) unexempted
